properties.label: Paired light and dark evidence
properties.text: Surround a compact list of four material criteria with two comparable product previews that share content structure while independently composing surface hierarchy and light.

properties.label: Stable criteria hierarchy
properties.text: Keep criterion labels and one stable explanation in a consistent hierarchy across all selected states.

properties.label: Independent light and dark neutrals
properties.text: Use opaque whites and tuned neutral values in light mode, and graphite planes with adjusted luminous edges in dark mode; keep accent semantics consistent while tuning luminance per theme.

properties.label: Theme-specific separation materials
properties.text: Separate light planes with soft contact shadows and dark planes with tonal steps and subtle edges, re-deriving the material treatment for each mode.

properties.label: Paired criterion inspection
properties.text: Selecting separation, accent, imagery or depth emphasizes corresponding evidence on both sides and updates one stable explanation; keyboard and touch expose the same states.

properties.label: No naive theme inversion
properties.text: Do not produce dark mode by merely inverting colors or dimming the light preview.

properties.label: Dual-theme hierarchy acceptance
properties.text: Preserve contrast, hierarchy, every criterion row and the selected state in both themes and on mobile.
